trust_decision.summary: Decided at the chmod/proxy sink and its copy: a package's bin path is resolved with realpath and only acted on if it stays inside the package's own install directory; unresolvable paths fail closed. Applied in BinaryInstaller::installBinaries and in FileDownloader::install, replacing the earlier string-only '..' check at the metadata layer.

landing_point.why: The summary says the earlier GHSA-gjfg-22fp-rrxx fix was bypassed; that fix is exactly this '..' bin-string rejection, so a reader lands here first and only then notices that the sink it protects is BinaryInstaller's chmod/proxy, never re-checked at the sink.

fix_sites.entry_point: composer install / update / reinstall -> LibraryInstaller::install|update|ensureBinariesPresence -> BinaryInstaller::installBinaries -> chmod + vendor/bin proxy creation
shared public static helper BinaryInstaller::isBinPathInsidePackage called from both guarded sites
DownloadManager::install -> FileDownloader::install for single-file dist packages -> chmod of $path/$bin

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The Downloader site only chmods bins of single-file dist packages, and BinaryInstaller::installBinaries runs later in the same install with a check, so that path 'cannot really reach' a host file.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Packages that legitimately ship a bin as a symlink to a file inside their own install dir (e.g. bin/tool -> ../src/tool.php), and single-file dist bins that must still be made executable, must keep working; an over-broad fix that rejects any is_link() or any bin whose realpath differs from its literal path breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: bin as a string vs bin as an array (ArrayLoader normalises string to array)
bin that is a symlink whose target is outside vs inside the package dir
bin path that cannot be resolved (realpath false -> fail closed)
bin with a leading '/' stripped by ltrim
bin path that is a directory (skipped before the check)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a 'symlink' bin-compat mode that links vendor/bin/<name> straight to the package bin instead of writing a proxy
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the class already branches on binCompat ('full'/'auto') and a symlink mode is an obvious third mode a maintainer could add for speed; the containment check would have to be repeated there

O8b_injection_room.sibling: chmod of path-repository bins during install, before BinaryInstaller runs
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: path repos are symlinked/junctioned into vendor and often need an executable bit; a maintainer fixing 'path repo bins are not executable' would add exactly this loop

O8b_injection_room.sibling: removeBinaries resolving and deleting the bin target outside the package
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: uninstall currently only removes binDir/basename($bin); a cleanup of the package bin itself would follow the same escaping path

O8b_injection_room.sibling: post-extraction chmod of the package's declared bins over the extracted tree
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the rar path already shells out a recursive 'chmod -R u+w' on the extraction dir; extending it to bins is a natural edit

O9_family: path traversal and symlink following (CWE-22/CWE-59) leading to chmod of an arbitrary host file (CWE-732)

O10_build.toolchain: composer (dev deps: symfony/phpunit-bridge -> simple-phpunit, phpstan); PHP ^7.2.5 || ^8.0
O10_build.project_tests: tests/Composer/Test/Installer/BinaryInstallerTest.php (tmp dirs, bin proxies) and tests/Composer/Test/Downloader/FileDownloaderTest.php; run via `composer test` / simple-phpunit; the symlink case needs OS symlink support and skips otherwise. No vendor/ dir is present, so the build itself needs network.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Extend/tighten the existing '..' string check in ValidatingArrayLoader (or do a string-prefix check in installBinaries) and stop, leaving realpath resolution and the FileDownloader::install chmod loop untouched.
